Outside the JavaScript syntax layer (`lib/javascript/syntax*.js`, `regexp.js`, `ScopeAnalyzer.js` and the generated tables), require `lib/javascript/syntax.js`, webpack's `javascript.syntax`, and read the parser from its `parser` getter (`const { Field, NodeType } = require("./syntax").parser`), never `syntax-parser.js` or `syntax-printer.js` directly, so the internals can move behind it. Type-only `@import`s may name `syntax-parser.js`. CSS and HTML do not follow this yet.

+**Every language's `syntax` facade and the JavaScript parser's `{ path: true }` taps are experimental**: tag each new public name they expose with `@experimental <where it is exposed>; unstable API` ([convention](docs/options.md)).

Every source file in `lib/`, `hot/` and `tooling/` opens with the MIT license header. A **new** file's `Author` line names its actual author (`Author <Name> @<github-handle>`), never copied from another file.
@@ -9,6 +9,7 @@ Read this before touching the CSS, HTML or JavaScript parser, printer or minifie
`lib/css/`, `lib/html/` and `lib/javascript/` each hold the same five pieces:
- `syntax.js` — a facade reaching `syntax-parser.js` (reads) and `syntax-printer.js` (writes) through getters, so a walk that never prints never loads the printer. It is neither parser nor printer.

+- Every export of a `syntax.js` facade, and of the JavaScript parser's `{ path: true }` taps (`PathTaps`, `nodeOfPath`, the `…ByPath` helpers), is experimental: its JSDoc carries `@experimental <where it is exposed>; unstable API`, and so does each public name added to it.

- `syntax-parser.js` / `syntax-printer.js` — algorithm only; every lookup table they read is in `data.js` — except generator-written regions such as the HTML entity table (`// #region html entities` in `lib/html/syntax-parser.js`) — generated by `tooling/generate-css-data.js`, `generate-html-data.js` or `generate-js-data.js` (see "Do not touch" in `AGENTS.md`).

- A minify entry the default minimizer dispatches to: `cssMinify.js`, `htmlMinify.js`, `jsMinify.js` — and `xmlMinify.js` for `.svg` and `.xml`, under `experiments.futureDefaults` or an `optimization.minimizeOptions.xml` object.

- A spec-conformance suite (`yarn test:css-parsing`, `test:html5lib`, `test:xmlconf`, `test:test262`) and the invariants and ecosystem comparison in [tooling/COMPARE_TOOLS.md](../tooling/COMPARE_TOOLS.md).
